description: Shows only the threads you touched in the last 24, 48 or 72 hours, so the sidebar holds today's work. A switch and a 24h / 48h / 72h picker sit at the top of the list; turn the switch off to see every project. Pinned threads, sections and child threads keep their places, and a thread that is open, running or waiting for your answer stays visible whatever its age. Each row shows when you last touched it, in English or Russian and a 12- or 24-hour clock.
